# dotkit

> dotkit is a zero-runtime CSS framework where every UI element is drawn as a collection of dots.
> One CSS file is the single source of truth; `dotkit/react` is a thin, stateless React binding (Server Component safe).
> Distributed via GitHub only (not on npm). Docs: https://daisuke-awaji.github.io/dotkit/

## Install
- Tarball: `npm i https://github.com/daisuke-awaji/dotkit/releases/download/v0.1.0/dotkit-0.1.0.tgz`
- Git semver: `npm i "github:daisuke-awaji/dotkit#semver:^0.1"`
- CDN: `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/daisuke-awaji/dotkit@v0.1.0/dist/dotkit.css` or `https://daisuke-awaji.github.io/dotkit/dotkit.css`
- Imports: `import "dotkit/css"` once; components from `dotkit/react`.

## Core variables
- `--dk-size` dot diameter (default 2px, transitionable), `--dk-gap` center distance (default 6px, transitionable), `--dk-color` dot color (currentColor)
- `--dk-value` 0..1 for meter/bar, `--dk-icon-step` icon dot step (icon size = step*7), `--dk-tone` halftone gradient (black = biggest dot)
- Theme tokens: `--dk-ink`, `--dk-paper`, `--dk-mute`, `--dk-subtle`, `--dk-radius`, `--dk-font-mono`. Dark theme: add `.dk-theme-dark` to an ancestor.
- All rules live in `@layer dotkit.base, dotkit.components, dotkit.utilities`; unlayered user CSS always wins (no !important needed).

## Classes
- Primitives: `.dk-dots` (dot fill), density `.dk-sparse|.dk-normal|.dk-dense`, shape `.dk-square|.dk-ring`, fade `.dk-fade-r|-l|-t|-b|-radial`
- `.dk-border` dotted outline (inherits border-radius)
- `.dk-halftone` (+ `--to-bottom|--to-left|--radial|--invert`) decorative; never put content inside
- `.dk-text` fills glyphs with dots (large text only)
- `.dk-icon .dk-icon--{name}` 7x7 icons (+ `.dk-icon--square`); color = currentColor
- `.dk-loader` with `<i>` children (max 8)
- `.dk-btn` + `.dk-btn--solid|--outline|--ghost` + `.dk-btn--sm|--lg`
- `.dk-badge` (+ `--solid`), `.dk-divider` (on <hr>), `.dk-field` wrapper + `.dk-input`
- `.dk-meter` (style `--dk-value`), `.dk-chart` > `.dk-bar` (style `--dk-value`), `.dk-card`

## React (dotkit/react)
- `<Dots density shape size gap color fade as>`; `<DotBorder …>`; `<DotText …>`; `<Halftone direction gap tone invert>`
- `<DotIcon name step square label>` (name: IconName, see `iconNames`)
- `<Button variant="solid|outline|ghost" size="sm|md|lg" shape>`; `buttonClassName({variant,size,shape})` for links
- `<Input leading trailing fieldClassName …inputProps>`; `<Badge variant>`; `<Divider gap size shape>`
- `<Meter value={0..1} label size gap shape>`; `<BarChart data={[{label,value}]} max height label size gap shape>`
- `<Card color shape as>`; `<Loader count size label>`
- Number values for size/gap/step are px.

## Icons
arrow-right, arrow-left, arrow-up, arrow-down, chevron-right, chevron-down, check, close, plus, minus, search, menu, home, user, mail, heart, star, info, alert, play, pause, sun, moon, copy, github, external
